Special functions

Source: R/functions-special.R, R/zzz-sym-names.R
special-functions.Rd

Symbolic special functions with special values, derivatives and numeric evaluation: the gamma family (gamma, loggamma, polygamma, digamma, trigamma, beta, lowergamma, uppergamma), factorials (factorial, factorial2, subfactorial, binomial, RisingFactorial, FallingFactorial), combinatorial numbers (bernoulli, fibonacci, lucas, tribonacci, catalan, bell, harmonic, euler, genocchi, partition, motzkin), error and exponential integrals (erf, erfc, erfi, erfinv, erfcinv, Ei, li, Si, Ci, Shi, Chi, expint, fresnels, fresnelc), zeta functions (zeta, dirichlet_eta, polylog, lerchphi), Bessel and Airy functions, elliptic integrals and orthogonal polynomials (legendre, assoc_legendre, chebyshevt, chebyshevu, hermite, hermite_prob, laguerre, assoc_laguerre, gegenbauer, jacobi, Ynm).

sym_beta(a, b)

sym_factorial(x)

sym_binomial(n, k, ...)

Arguments

...

Arguments.

x, a, b, n, k

Arguments.

k_sym, symbols

For bell(): the second index of the incomplete Bell polynomial and the list of its symbols.

Value

A sym expression.

Details

sym_factorial() and sym_beta() dispatch to the base R functions for numeric input.

Examples

sym_factorial(S(20))
#> 2432902008176640000
sym_binomial(Symbol("n"), 2)
#> binomial(n, 2)
zeta(S(2))
#> pi^2/6
legendre(3, Symbol("x"))
#> 5*x^3/2 - 3*x/2
